title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Bonus Points Table
content:
Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards credits three kinds of one-time bonus points, each fixed per tier: an enrollment bonus when a new membership is verified, a tier bonus when a member first reaches a tier in a program year, and a referral bonus to the referring member when a business it referred is verified.

| Tier | Enrollment bonus: points credited once when a new membership is verified | Tier bonus: points credited once when the member first reaches this tier in a program year | Referral bonus: points credited to the referring member when a referred business is verified |
|---|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Member | 500 | 0 | 250 |
| ProBuild Bronze | 0 | 500 | 250 |
| ProBuild Silver | 0 | 1000 | 500 |
| ProBuild Gold | 0 | 2500 | 500 |
| ProBuild Platinum | 0 | 5000 | 1000 |
| ProBuild Platinum Elite | 0 | 10000 | 1000 |

## Points of reading

- **A zero entry.** Where the table shows 0, the bonus at that tier credits no points: the enrollment bonus is 500 points at ProBuild Member and 0 at every other tier, and the tier bonus is 0 at ProBuild Member.
- **Once.** The enrollment bonus is credited once when the membership is verified; the tier bonus is credited once when the member first reaches the tier in a program year.
- **Hypothetical referral.** A referring member at ProBuild Platinum receives 1000 points when the business it referred is verified; a referring member at ProBuild Bronze receives 250.
